messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — ACME capacity bring-up tomorrow 10:00am PST. Need final sign-off on quota numbers, autoscale policy, and a short shadow load + smoke. I put a checklist below. @raj_infra @leo_sre @anya_ops can you confirm availability and any blockers?

maria_cs: Checklist: 1) Reserve pool id rsv-acme-12 2) Quota: 2,000 concurrent tokens (peak) / 20k rps tokens 3) Autoscale policy: target p95 latency < 300ms, min_burst 150, max_pool 400 4) Run 15m shadow load @ 70% expected peak, then 5m smoke at full burst 5) Capture perf traces + cost delta.

raj_infra: on it. reserved pool already staged (rsv-acme-12). Can we lock the quota to 2,000 concurrent but allow burst to 2.5k for 10m if needed?

leo_sre: +1 to reserving burst but want autoscale cooldown 60s to avoid oscillation. Also set fallback model to small-quantized for < 100ms degrade path.

anya_ops: FYI renewal review is Wed — product team will ask for metrics from this run. Please tag runs with `acme-2026-renew` so we can export perf/cost.

raj_infra: ACK. Autoscale policy we'll apply: `dedicated-acme-v1` (min_instances: 3, max_instances: 25, scale_window: 60s, target_p95_ms: 300). Will attach policy id after deploy.

maria_cs: perfect. Can someone paste the exact load command we'll run so I can include in the playbook?

leo_sre: putting the k6 job we'll use — shadow against staging endpoint with header X-Shadow-Account: acme. Run 70% traffic for 15m, then ramp to 100% for 5m. Add traces header.

leo_sre: ```
# shadow run (15m @70%)
k6 run --vus 140 --duration 15m loadtests/acme-shadow.js \
  --env TARGET=https://staging-api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  --tag run=acme-shadow-70 --tag phase=shadow --header "X-Shadow-Account: acme" --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086

# smoke (5m @100%)
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 5m loadtests/acme-smoke.js \
  --env TARGET=https://staging-api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  --tag run=acme-smoke-100 --tag phase=smoke --header "X-Shadow-Account: acme" --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086
```

maria_cs: saved, thanks. leo — add runbook link to the calendar invite?

leo_sre: added runbook + tracing tags. also: oncall for the window is leo_sre -> raj_infra (fallback). I added a quick rollback note: if p95 > 800ms for 3 consecutive minutes, trigger rollout -> fallback-model.

raj_infra: deploy-bot reports reserved pool spin-up complete for rsv-acme-12 :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: reserved pool rsv-acme-12 created (id: rp-9831). Autoscale policy `dedicated-acme-v1` attached.

anya_ops: Can CS/product people hop into a short 30m readiness call 30m before start? I want to confirm logging + the customer-facing checklist for renewal.

maria_cs: yes. scheduling now — invite sent for 9:30am PST. Please RSVP.

leo_sre: small note — increase retention for traces for this run to 14d so product can download full spans. I'll toggle retention flag pre-run.

anya_ops: capturing success metrics we need: p95 latency, error rate, cost per 1k tokens, model fallback count, KV-cache hit rate. Product wants CSV export.

maria_cs: got it. I'll own the CSV export and share to ACME post-run. Also will collect qualitative feedback via the enablement form.

raj_infra: one last thing — quota enforcement window: enable hard-quota after 20 minutes post-shadow to avoid prematurely throttling customer traffic.

leo_sre: agreed. we'll enable soft-cap during shadow. Hard-cap only if safety threshold hit.

maria_cs: Awesome — thanks everyone. Summary: pool rp-9831, policy dedicated-acme-v1, shadow 15m@70% -> smoke 5m@100%, readiness call 9:30am PST, oncall leo_sre/raj_infra, tag runs with acme-2026-renew. I'll post a short post-mortem with metrics. :thumbsup:

anya_ops: :thumbsup: Good luck — ping me if any signals look off during run.

leo_sre: see you tomorrow.

(End of thread)
